selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What topic is being asked about in this passage?
questions.answer: The passage is about why the five daily prayers are connected to certain specific times.

questions.question: How many examples of wisdom in the prayer times does the speaker say will be explained here?
questions.answer: Only one example is said to be explained.

questions.question: What does each prayer time mark besides being a time on the clock?
questions.answer: Each one points to a major change or turning point.

questions.question: What are the prayer times said to reflect about Allah’s power?
questions.answer: They show Allah’s control and action in the world.

questions.question: What do the prayer times show about Allah’s blessings?
questions.answer: They reflect the many blessings spread throughout creation.

questions.question: Why is extra glorification and praise connected to those times?
questions.answer: Because those times are linked to Allah’s power and to the blessings gathered between one prayer time and the next.

questions.question: What is one meaning of the prescribed prayers in this passage?
questions.answer: They include praising Allah, exalting Him, and thanking Him for countless blessings.

questions.question: What does the listener need to do in order to understand this deep meaning a little?
questions.answer: The listener needs to pay attention to the five points that will be explained.

questions.question: Which daily acts of worship are the main subject of this passage?
questions.answer: The main subject is the five daily prayers.

questions.question: How are the times of prayer described in relation to big events or changes?
questions.answer: They are described as signs of important changes.

questions.question: What does the passage say these times are a mirror to?
questions.answer: They are a mirror to divine power at work and to universal blessings.

questions.question: According to the passage, why are people told to glorify Allah more at these times?
questions.answer: Because these times clearly show His power and His management of creation.

questions.question: Why are thanks especially suitable at the prayer times?
questions.answer: Because many blessings have been received in the period between one prayer time and the next.

questions.question: What does the passage suggest about the number of blessings a person receives?
questions.answer: It suggests that the blessings are too many to count.

questions.question: How is the meaning being described in the passage?
questions.answer: It is described as subtle and deep.

questions.question: What method is used to help the listener understand that meaning?
questions.answer: The method is to explain it through five points.

questions.question: What question from the listener starts this discussion?
questions.answer: The listener asks about the wisdom behind the set times of the five daily prayers.

questions.question: Does the passage claim to give every wisdom behind the prayer times or only part of it?
questions.answer: It gives only part of it.

questions.question: What two things does each prayer time reflect according to the passage?
questions.answer: It reflects major changes and also Allah’s power and blessings.

questions.question: What idea connects the prayer times to praising Allah?
questions.answer: Since those times display Allah’s power and gifts, they are fitting times to praise Him more.

questions.question: What idea connects the prayer times to thanking Allah?
questions.answer: Since blessings build up between the prayer times, those moments are fitting for gratitude.

questions.question: What does this passage teach about prayer and daily life?
questions.answer: It teaches that prayer is tied to the changes of life and to noticing Allah’s blessings throughout the day.

questions.question: Who is told to listen carefully along with the speaker?
questions.answer: The speaker’s own nafs is included along with the listener.

questions.question: What comes next to help explain the meaning of the prayer times?
questions.answer: Five points are going to be presented.
